verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for an analytics SaaS platform, but the evidence pack never documents Amplitude's own source code being published under an open license. The only 'open-source' mention (amplitude-intdir-6) describes Google's Flutter UI toolkit, not Amplitude's code, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
